items.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: Billy Bergen. Red Hot we call them.

ctx.x: He plays in St. Lafonses' Arden on Sunday. Right there. You know where I first heard Tom was up uh Audubon Park with uh Red Hot Bergen. Oh yeah. And that was a good band there. Oh yes. With Harry Shields on clarinet. I know.
Billy Bergen. Red Hot we call them.
And let's see over here you have the original band you say. Yeah. Except that Larry Shields was taking Gussie's place. That's right. Correct.
